description.text: Microelectronics and Solid State Electronics is the base and pillar of electronic engineering and information science and technology. This master-degree program is jointly applied with the key national defense laboratory of analog integrated circuits (under the 24th Research Institute of Chinese Electronics Science and Technology Corporation), with a research body of high -quality professors, associate professors, researchers and senior engineers. One of the "11th Five-Year Plan" key disciplines of Chongqing City it is equipped with a municipal microelectronics engineering laboratory, and undertakes the necessary task of training talents for the integrated circuit manufacturing industry chain for China and for Chongqing Municipality in particular. Since the "10th-Five-Year", teachers in the discipline have carried out more than 10 key scientific research projects including the "863" program, the National Natural Science Fund, the provincial, ministerial and national projects, won 5 provincial and ministerial science and technology awards. Nearly 10 patents are obtained and nearly 400 papers have been published. The discipline conducts researches mainly in structures, properties and preparation technology of various solid electronic materials, manufacturing and testing technology of various electronic components (including active, passive, power and sensitive or operative components), manufacturing technology, designing technology and methods, reliability technology and testing methods.

duration.text: The Microelectronics and Solid state Electronics at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 6 or above
